posts.title: Splitting Accordion Reeds
posts.description: View on YouTube or Instagram I got these vintage accordion reeds from ebay ages ago. They have been sitting on my shelf for over a year. I’ve calculated that they have gained as much as 1% more vintage in that time. These accordion reeds are unlike their neighbours who came from pump organs. posts.title: Pump Organ resources, online and off
posts.description: Here I’m collecting the links and notes about harmoniums, pump organs, and brass reeds as I learn more. This has spilled into adjacent instruments too (from pipe organs to concertinas). Let me know if you have any recommendations!
